nodes.title: ∬ over a rectangle
steps: Pick the order with the easy inner integral (x·e^(xy) → dy first).
Inner integral, other variable constant.
Outer integral.
nodes.formula:
∬R f dA = ∫a→b ∫c→d f dy dx
        = ∫c→d ∫a→b f dx dy
Area = ∬ 1 dA
V = ∬ f dA  (f ≥ 0)
f = g(x)h(y) ⇒ (∫g dx)(∫h dy)
A(x) = ∫c→d f(x,y) dy
V = ∫a→b A(x) dx = ∫c→d A(y) dy

choices.label: Integral looks like a known solid?

nodes.title: ∬ General region
steps: Sketch; intersections by setting curves equal.
Vertical line always enters/exits same curves → Type I. Horizontal → Type II.
Neither → split at the corner, add.
Outer bounds numbers, inner bounds curves.
nodes.formula:
Type I:  ∫a→b ∫g₁(x)→g₂(x) f dy dx
Type II: ∫c→d ∫h₁(y)→h₂(y) f dx dy
Line through 2 pts: y = y₁ + m(x − x₁)
V between surfaces = ∬D (top − bottom) dA
nodes.warn: Pick the type that avoids splitting.

nodes.title: Reverse the order
nodes.body: Use when the inner integral is non-elementary: e^(x²), sin(y²), √(1+x³), cos x·√(9+cos²x)…
steps: Bounds → inequalities → sketch, label corners.
New outer variable: numeric min → max.
Solve boundaries for new inner variable.
Inner: curve entered → curve exited. Split if it changes.
nodes.formula:
∫0→1 ∫x²→1 f dy dx = ∫0→1 ∫0→√y f dx dy
y = x² ⇔ x = √y
x = arcsin y ⇔ y = sin x
x = ln y ⇔ y = eˣ
nodes.warn: Never just swap dx and dy.

nodes.title: Example
nodes.body:
∫0→1 ∫y→1 e^(x²) dx dy
Region: triangle (0,0),(1,0),(1,1)
= ∫0→1 ∫0→x e^(x²) dy dx = ∫0→1 x e^(x²) dx = ½(e − 1)

nodes.title: Polar ∬
steps: Convert region and integrand.
Multiply by r.
dr first, then dθ.
nodes.formula:
x = r cosθ, y = r sinθ
x² + y² = r²,  tanθ = y/x
dA = r dr dθ
∬ f dA = ∫α→β ∫r₁→r₂ f(r cosθ, r sinθ) r dr dθ

nodes.title: Polar bounds
nodes.body: θ goes counterclockwise; it may start negative (−π/4 → 3π/4).
nodes.formula:
Disk: 0≤r≤R, 0≤θ≤2π
Annulus: R₁ ≤ r ≤ R₂
QI: 0→π/2 · upper half: 0→π
right half: −π/2→π/2
y = mx: θ = arctan m
  y=x: π/4 · y=√3x: π/3 · y=x/√3: π/6
x²+y² = 2ax: r = 2a cosθ, −π/2→π/2
x²+y² = 2ay: r = 2a sinθ, 0→π
y = c: r = c cscθ · x = c: r = c secθ

nodes.title: Area inside r = g(θ)
nodes.body: θ range: where the curve starts and ends in the picture.
nodes.formula: A = ∫α→β ∫0→g(θ) r dr dθ = ∫α→β ½ g(θ)² dθ

nodes.title: Cartesian → polar
nodes.body: Read the bounds as a region first, then write polar bounds.
nodes.formula:
y: 0→√(R²−x²) ⇒ upper half disk
x: ±√(R²−y²) ⇒ full disk
y: 0→√(2ax−x²), x: 0→2a
  ⇒ 0≤r≤2a cosθ, 0≤θ≤π/2
√(x²+y²) → r,  x²+y² → r²

nodes.title: Surface area
steps: D = shadow on xy-plane (inside x²+y² = R² ⇒ disk; below z = h ⇒ f ≤ h).
Radicand has x²+y² → polar, keep the r.
Constant radicand → factor × Area(D).
nodes.formula:
z = f(x,y):
A = ∬D √(1 + f_x² + f_y²) dA
Plane ax+by+cz = d:
A = (√(a²+b²+c²)/|c|)·Area(D)
Sphere z = √(a² − r²): √(…) = a/√(a² − r²)
Paraboloid z = x²+y²: √(1 + 4r²)
Parametric: A = ∬ |r_u × r_v| du dv

nodes.title: ∭ Cartesian
steps: Inner variable = one with clear floor/ceiling.
Shadow D: set top = bottom, plus walls.
Describe D as Type I/II.
nodes.formula:
∭E f dV = ∬D ∫u₁(x,y)→u₂(x,y) f dz dA
V = ∭ 1 dV = ∬D (top − bottom) dA
Tetrahedron x/a + y/b + z/c = 1:
  z: 0→c(1 − x/a − y/b)
  y: 0→b(1 − x/a),  x: 0→a
  V = abc/6
nodes.warn: A bound may only use outer variables.

nodes.title: Change ∭ order
steps: Write all 6 inequalities; sketch.
Solve surfaces for the new inner variable.
Shadow on the other two: eliminate the inner variable (set its surfaces equal / substitute).
Describe the shadow in the new order; split if needed.

nodes.title: Six orders
nodes.body:
y = x², z = 0, y + 2z = 4
dz dy dx: x −2→2, y x²→4, z 0→(4−y)/2
dz dx dy: y 0→4, x ±√y, z 0→(4−y)/2
dx dz dy: y 0→4, z 0→(4−y)/2, x ±√y
dx dy dz: z 0→2, y 0→4−2z, x ±√y
dy dz dx: x −2→2, z 0→(4−x²)/2, y x²→4−2z
dy dx dz: z 0→2, x ±√(4−2z), y x²→4−2z

nodes.title: Cylindrical
steps: z: bottom → top surface.
r: 0 → shadow edge (top = bottom, or wall).
θ: 0→2π unless cut.
nodes.formula:
x = r cosθ, y = r sinθ, z = z
dV = r dz dr dθ
∫θ ∫r ∫z f(r cosθ, r sinθ, z) r dz dr dθ
cylinder x²+y² = R² → r = R
cone z = k√(x²+y²) → z = kr
paraboloid z = a ± (x²+y²) → a ± r²
sphere → z = ±√(R² − r²)
plane z = y → z = r sinθ
x²+y² = 2ax → r = 2a cosθ
nodes.warn: The extra r. Cone z = r is above paraboloid z = r² for 0<r<1.

choices.label: Axis is x or y (x = y²+z²)

nodes.title: Around the x-axis
nodes.body: Integrand x stays x. Same idea for the y-axis with x, z.
nodes.formula:
x = a(y² + z²), plane x = c
y = r cosθ, z = r sinθ
x: ar² → c,  r: 0 → √(c/a),  θ: 0→2π
dV = r dx dr dθ

nodes.title: Spherical
steps: ρ: origin outward to the surface (may depend on φ).
φ from the +z axis.
Constant bounds ⇒ product of 3 integrals.
nodes.formula:
x = ρ sinφ cosθ
y = ρ sinφ sinθ
z = ρ cosφ
ρ² = x²+y²+z²,  r = ρ sinφ
dV = ρ² sinφ dρ dφ dθ
0 ≤ φ ≤ π,  0 ≤ θ ≤ 2π
nodes.warn: ρ² sinφ. φ is from the z-axis, θ is around it.

nodes.title: Spherical bounds
nodes.formula:
Ball: ρ 0→R, φ 0→π, θ 0→2π
Upper half: φ 0→π/2
First octant: φ, θ both 0→π/2
Inside sphere, above cone φ₀: φ 0→φ₀
Outside cone (z ≥ 0): φ φ₀→π/2
Shell: R₁ ≤ ρ ≤ R₂
x²+y²+z² = 2az: ρ ≤ 2a cosφ
Below plane z = h: ρ ≤ h secφ
Cap above z = h: h secφ ≤ ρ ≤ R,
  φ ≤ arccos(h/R)

nodes.title: Cones & surfaces
nodes.formula:
z = √(x²+y²): φ = π/4
z = √3·√(x²+y²): φ = π/6
z = √(x²+y²)/√3: φ = π/3
z = k√(x²+y²): tanφ = 1/k
sphere radius R: ρ = R
plane z = h: ρ = h secφ
cylinder x²+y² = a²: ρ = a cscφ
xy-plane: φ = π/2

nodes.title: Mass, centroid, average
steps: Symmetry first: round around z-axis ⇒ x̄ = ȳ = 0.
Uniform δ cancels: use V (or A).
Spherical z = ρ cosφ ⇒ integrand ρ³ sinφ cosφ.
nodes.formula:
2D: m = ∬ δ dA
M_y = ∬ xδ dA,  M_x = ∬ yδ dA
x̄ = M_y/m,  ȳ = M_x/m
3D: m = ∭ δ dV
x̄ = ∭ xδ dV / m  (same for ȳ, z̄)
f_avg = ∬ f dA / Area(D)
nodes.warn: z̄ must lie inside the solid.

nodes.title: Cone in x²+y²+z² = 2z
nodes.body:
ρ 0→2cosφ, φ 0→π/4, θ 0→2π
V = 2π∫(8cos³φ/3) sinφ dφ = π
M = 2π∫4cos⁵φ sinφ dφ = 7π/6
z̄ = 7/6

nodes.title: Line ∫ f ds
steps: Parameterize.
Speed |r'(t)|.
Plug in and integrate.
nodes.formula:
∫C f ds = ∫a→b f(r(t)) |r'(t)| dt
ds = √(x'² + y'² + z'²) dt
Mass = ∫ δ ds,  Length = ∫ ds
∫C f dx = ∫ f(r(t)) x'(t) dt
∫C f dy = ∫ f(r(t)) y'(t) dt
nodes.warn: ds needs the speed; dx and dy don't.

nodes.title: Parameterizations
nodes.body: Piecewise path: one piece at a time, then add.
nodes.formula:
Segment A→B: r = A + t(B − A), 0≤t≤1
Circle CCW: (a cos t, a sin t), 0→2π
Ellipse: (a cos t, b sin t)
y = g(x): (t, g(t))
x = g(y): (g(t), t)
Helix: (cos t, sin t, t)

nodes.title: Work ∫ F·dr
steps: Shortcuts: closed plane curve → Green; curl F = 0 → potential.

Else parameterize, dot F(r(t)) with r'(t), integrate.
Pick-the-figure: arrow at r(t) is F(r(t)), slope F_y/F_x.
nodes.formula:
W = ∫C F·dr = ∫a→b F(r(t))·r'(t) dt
  = ∫C P dx + Q dy + R dz
∫−C F·dr = −∫C F·dr

nodes.title: Conservative fields
steps: f = ∫ P dx + g(y,z).
f_y = Q ⇒ g.
f_z = R ⇒ h(z).
Answer f(end) − f(start).
nodes.formula:
2D: P_y = Q_x
3D: curl F = 0
  P_y = Q_x, P_z = R_x, Q_z = R_y
∫C ∇f·dr = f(B) − f(A)
∮ ∇f·dr = 0
nodes.warn: Needs a simply connected domain (no holes).

nodes.title: Green's theorem
steps: P = dx coefficient, Q = dy coefficient.
∬D (Q_x − P_y) dA.
Constant k ⇒ k·Area(D).
Direct check: each edge A + t(B − A), sum.
nodes.formula:
∮C P dx + Q dy = ∬D (Q_x − P_y) dA
CCW = positive; CW ⇒ negate
Area = ∮ x dy = −∮ y dx
     = ½∮ (x dy − y dx)
nodes.warn: Q_x − P_y, Q first. Closed curve only.

nodes.title: Example
nodes.body:
∮ y² dx + 3xy dy, triangle (0,0)→(1,0)→(1,2)
Green: Q_x − P_y = y; ∫0→1 ∫0→2x y dy dx = 2/3
Direct: 0 + 6 − 16/3 = 2/3

nodes.title: grad · div · curl
nodes.formula:
∇f = ⟨f_x, f_y, f_z⟩   S→V
∇·F = P_x + Q_y + R_z   V→S
∇×F = ⟨R_y−Q_z, P_z−R_x, Q_x−P_y⟩   V→V
∇²f = f_xx + f_yy + f_zz   S→S
∇×(∇f) = 0
∇·(∇×F) = 0
∇·(∇f) = ∇²f

nodes.title: r and r = |r|
nodes.formula:
∇r = r/r
∇×r = 0,  ∇·r = 3
∇(1/r) = −r/r³
∇(ln r) = r/r²
∇g(r) = g'(r)·r/r
∇(rⁿ) = n rⁿ⁻² r

nodes.title: Meaningful?
nodes.body:
Track scalar/vector inside out.
OK: div(grad f), curl(grad f), grad(div F), div(curl F), curl(curl F)
Nonsense: curl(div F), div(div F), grad(grad f), grad F, div f

nodes.title: Points & solids
nodes.body:
Describing a solid:
θ 0→π/2: x, y ≥ 0 · θ 0→π: y ≥ 0
r ≤ z or φ ≤ π/2: z ≥ 0
z = c plane · z = r cone · ρ = c sphere · φ = c cone
xz-plane slice: θ = 0, π · yz-plane: θ = π/2
nodes.formula:
Cyl (r, θ, z) → (r cosθ, r sinθ, z)
Sph (ρ, θ, φ) →
  (ρ sinφ cosθ, ρ sinφ sinθ, ρ cosφ)
r = √(x²+y²), tanθ = y/x
ρ = √(x²+y²+z²), cosφ = z/ρ
nodes.warn: Spherical points are (ρ, θ, φ): θ second.

nodes.title: Symmetry
nodes.body:
D symmetric across the y-axis and f(−x,y) = −f(x,y) ⇒ ∬ f dA = 0.
Same for y/x-axis, and in 3D.
∬ x dA, ∬ xy² dA over a disk = 0.
Solid round about z-axis ⇒ x̄ = ȳ = 0.
∫0→2π sinθ dθ = ∫0→2π cosθ dθ = 0.

nodes.title: Choosing the order
nodes.body:
Constant bounds + f = g(x)h(y): split into a product.
x·e^(xy), x·cos(xy): integrate dy first (x is the chain-rule factor).
Non-elementary inner (e^(x²), sin(y²)): reverse the order; the new inner creates the u-sub factor.
Pick the order that avoids splitting the region.

nodes.title: Known areas & volumes
nodes.body: If f ≥ 0 and the solid is a known shape, skip the integral.
nodes.formula:
Disk πR² · sector ½R²θ
Ellipse πab · triangle ½bh
Triangle from vertices:
  ½|x₁(y₂−y₃) + x₂(y₃−y₁) + x₃(y₁−y₂)|
Ball 4πR³/3 · hemisphere 2πR³/3
Cone πR²h/3 · cylinder πR²h
Half cylinder ½πR²·L
  (∬ √(R² − x²) over full width)

nodes.title: Trig
nodes.body: Odd power: peel one factor, sin² = 1 − cos², u = cos.
nodes.formula:
sin²θ = (1 − cos2θ)/2
cos²θ = (1 + cos2θ)/2
sinθ cosθ = ½ sin2θ
∫0→2π sin² = ∫0→2π cos² = π
∫0→π/2 sin² = π/4
∫0→π sinφ = 2 · ∫0→π/2 sinφ = 1
∫0→π/4 sinφ = 1 − √2/2
∫0→π/2 sin³φ = 2/3
π/6: (√3/2, ½) · π/4: (√2/2, √2/2)
π/3: (½, √3/2)  as (cos, sin)

nodes.title: u-sub patterns
nodes.formula:
∫ x e^(x²) dx = ½ e^(x²)
∫ r e^(−r²) dr = −½ e^(−r²)
∫ r√(1+4r²) dr = (1+4r²)^(3/2)/12
∫ r/√(a²−r²) dr = −√(a²−r²)
∫ cosⁿφ sinφ dφ = −cosⁿ⁺¹φ/(n+1)
∫ ρ³ e^(ρ²) dρ: u = ρ², then parts
∫ 1/(1+x²) = arctan x

nodes.title: By parts
nodes.formula:
∫ u dv = uv − ∫ v du
u by LIATE: Log, Inv trig, Alg, Trig, Exp
∫ x eˣ dx = (x − 1)eˣ
∫ x cos x dx = x sin x + cos x
∫ x sin x dx = sin x − x cos x
∫ ln x dx = x ln x − x

nodes.title: Line integral rules
nodes.body:
Reverse path: ∫F·dr flips sign; ∫f ds doesn't.
∫ g(x) dx alone depends only on x-endpoints.
Conservative + closed ⇒ 0.
Speed: circle radius a = a; segment = |B − A|.
Closed curve, messy edges ⇒ Green.
F mostly along motion ⇒ positive work.

nodes.title: Sanity checks
nodes.body:
Jacobian: r (polar/cyl), ρ² sinφ (sph).
Outer bounds are numbers; lower < upper.
Volume, area, mass, length > 0.
Centroid inside the solid.
CW or reversed path ⇒ flip sign.
Radians.
½ for triangles.
